annotations.title: Content Metadata & C2PA Marker Inspector API

description: Content Metadata & C2PA Marker Inspector API: Inspect C2PA box markers and EXIF/XMP metadata tags (heuristic header signals, not authenticity proof). (Endpoint: POST /v1/content-provenance)

content_base64.description: Base64-encoded file header or full file bytes (up to ~128 KB) of JPEG, PNG, WebP, PDF, or MP4.

metadata_text.description: Optional raw EXIF, XMP, PNG tEXt/iTXt, or JSON metadata dump to inspect alongside or instead of binary bytes.

name: tinplate_content_provenance
